# Agents Catalog

This repository supports multiple Copilot agent profiles.

## Available agents
1) Frontend Angular Developer — /agents/frontend-angular-developer
2) Software Architect — /agents/software-architect
3) Site Reliability Engineer — /agents/sre-engineer

## How to use
- Open Copilot Chat and paste the prompt template from the agent folder.
- Or navigate to the relevant module folder where an AGENTS.md exists (nearest AGENTS.md wins).
